idea-plugin.name: KMP Device Hub
idea-plugin.description:
Every Android device, emulator and iOS simulator in one panel. Built for Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform developers who test on Android and iOS every day.

  • See running and stopped Android emulators, connected phones and iOS simulators together; start and stop them.
  • Launch, stop, clear data and uninstall your app; its Android and iOS ids are found in your project.
  • Grant and revoke permissions, switch dark mode and text size, and run your app in another language (RTL too).
  • Open deep links, take screenshots, and pair Android phones over Wi-Fi.
  • Network Inspector: every API call your app makes (Ktor or OkHttp), with headers, bodies, a JSON tree, errors, timings, throughput and device connectivity. Copy any call as cURL.

Pro (free trial on JetBrains Marketplace):

  • Apply anything to all running devices at once.
  • Test presets: dark mode + largest text, right-to-left, slow network, offline, store screenshots, or your own.
  • Screen recording, a push notification tester and a deep link library.
  • Simulated location, Android emulator network conditions and a clean 9:41 status bar.
  • Mock responses, fail requests or add latency from the Network Inspector; export HAR files.

Works with the tools you already have: the Android SDK and, on macOS, Xcode.
